name: Roller-operation qualifier
summary: This qualifier identifies contact with a roller-operated mechanism.
description: This qualifier identifies contact with a roller-operated mechanism. A roller receives mechanical movement from another part and transfers it to the operating mechanism. It often helps explain a positional switch relationship on a machine or moving assembly.
Associate the mechanism with the physical position or movement it senses. Keep the corresponding electrical contact state and equipment tag explicit in the schematic.
readingNotes: Associate the roller with its driven position and contact operating condition.
A roller qualifier identifies actuation, not the electrical contact rating.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Associate the roller with its driven position and contact operating condition.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: A roller qualifier identifies actuation, not the electrical contact rating.
